Herning is a Danish municipality whose healthcare data is featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Regional Clinical Quality Improvement Program (RKKP) [^src1]. The report serves as a critical tool for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system, analyzing clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across national, regional, and municipal levels [^src1].

Within the report, Herning is specifically evaluated under Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke among atrial fibrillation patients via anticoagulation treatment [^src1]. This indicator relies on data from the DanStroke registry and the Danish National Patient Registry (LPR) [^src1]. Herning's specific municipal statistics, including patient denominators and stroke event rates, are detailed in the report's comprehensive breakdown of all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1].
